user_input: I bought a phone for ₹15,000 online. It has stopped working within 10 days. I have the invoice and unboxing video.
expected: Identify defective goods; cite CPA 2019 Sec 2(47); suggest NCH 1915 and formal complaint.
actual_response:
[LawPilot AI — Grounded Demo Mode]

### 🛒 Consumer Rights Analysis: Defective Product & Refund Refusal

**1. Legal Assessment of Your Situation:**
You purchased a product that turned out defective, and the seller/platform is unlawfully refusing a refund or replacement.

**2. Applicable Indian Consumer Laws:**
- **[The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 — Section 12](https://nalsa.gov.in/)**: Criteria for giving legal services (Free Legal Aid via NALSA / SLSA / DLSA)
- **[State Shops and Commercial Establishments Acts — Settlement of Dues and Service Conditions Provision](https://shramsuvidha.gov.in/)**: Statutory Payment of Earned Salary and Notice Pay for Private/Commercial Employees
- **[The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 106](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2338?view_type=browse&sam_handle=123456789/1362)**: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
- **[The Transfer of Property Act, 1882 — Section 108(m) & (o)](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2338?view_type=browse&sam_handle=123456789/1362)**: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
- **Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Section 2(47)):** Refusing to withdraw defective goods or refund consideration within the agreed period (or within 30 days) constitutes an explicit **Unfair Trade Practice**.
- **Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Section 35 & 84):** Gives consumers the right to file a complaint before the District Consumer Commission and claim product liability damages.
- **Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020:** Mandates platforms to accept returns and resolve consumer complaints within 30 days.

**3. Essential Evidence to Preserve:**
- Purchase tax invoice / order receipt.
- Photos or unboxing video demonstrating the defect.
- Customer support communication and rejection emails.

**4. Practical Next Steps:**
1. **National Consumer Helpline (NCH):** Register a complaint immediately via **1915** or online at https://consumerhelpline.gov.in/.
2. **Issue a Formal Refund Notice:** Send a registered 15-day demand notice.
3. **File via e-Daakhil:** Submit an e-complaint before the District Consumer Commission without requiring a lawyer.

👉 **Next Question for You:** Which city or state is the property or company located in? (Tenancy and shops laws vary by state).

citations.title: Duration of certain leases in absence of written contract or local usage
citations.description: In the absence of a contract or local law to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for other than agricultural or manufacturing purposes is deemed to be month-to-month, terminable on 15 days' notice expiring with the end of a month of the tenancy.

citations.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee - Repairs and Reasonable Wear and Tear
citations.description: Lessee is bound to keep and restore the property in as good condition as it was at the time he was put in possession, subject only to reasonable wear and tear and irresistible force. Landlord cannot make arbitrary deductions for normal usage painting without explicit contractual basis.
